title: Roadmap shows pass headings so { and } jump to visible groups

sections.heading: Why
sections.body: S151 UI pass (2026-10-27): { and } on the Roadmap jump between runs of items with the same pass, but the Roadmap rows (internal/tui/roadmap.go:183-201) draw only size and effort, so the owner cannot see the boundaries. Show the pass: a dim heading line per pass, or a pass column. Changes the Roadmap goldens.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body: Tests first. Owner picks heading line versus column at preflight. UI slice: UI pass (r14).

sections.heading: Check
sections.body: go test -race ./internal/tui; goldens; go vet; gofmt -l; slicer check; adj lint.
